title: Epic: Security & Data Protection
description: Security implementation including Row Level Security (RLS) policies on Supabase, Keychain token storage, file protection for SwiftData, and secure logout with data isolation.

title: Verify RLS Policies in Supabase
description: Verify RLS policies are correctly configured on todos table. Test that users can only access their own data. Test SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE operations with different user contexts.
design: In Supabase SQL Editor: 1. Verify RLS enabled: SELECT * FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename = 'todos'. 2. Test as user_1: SET LOCAL jwt.claims.sub = 'user_1_uuid'; SELECT * FROM todos; (should return only user_1's todos). 3. Test cross-user access: SET LOCAL jwt.claims.sub = 'user_1_uuid'; UPDATE todos SET title = 'hacked' WHERE id = 'user_2_todo_id'; (should affect 0 rows). 4. Test anonymous access: RESET LOCAL jwt.claims; SELECT * FROM todos; (should return 0 rows). Files: Documentation of test results.
acceptance_criteria: [ ] RLS enabled on todos table, [ ] User sees only their own todos, [ ] Cross-user UPDATE affects 0 rows, [ ] Cross-user DELETE affects 0 rows, [ ] Anonymous access returns 0 rows, [ ] All 4 policies present (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), [ ] Policies use auth.uid() correctly

title: Implement File Protection for SwiftData
description: Enable iOS File Protection on SwiftData database file. Use .complete protection level to encrypt data when device is locked. Protect user data if device is lost/stolen.
design: Modify aatodoApp.swift where ModelContainer is configured. After container creation, get URL of database file. Use FileManager to set attributes: [FileAttributeKey.protectionKey: FileProtectionType.complete]. Implementation: let config = ModelConfiguration(...). let container = try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: [config]). if let url = config.url { let attributes = [FileAttributeKey.protectionKey: FileProtectionType.complete]; try FileManager.default.setAttributes(attributes, ofItemAtPath: url.path) }. Files: aatodoApp.swift
acceptance_criteria: [ ] File Protection attributes set, [ ] .complete protection level used, [ ] Database file encrypted when device locked, [ ] Data inaccessible without device passcode, [ ] File attributes verified with FileManager.default.attributesOfItem

title: Implement Secure Logout with Data Cleanup
description: Enhance AuthViewModel.signOut() to properly clean up user data. Call Supabase logout, clear Keychain tokens, delete user's local todos from SwiftData. Prevent data leakage between users.
design: Modify ViewModels/AuthViewModel.swift. In signOut() method: 1. Try await supabase.auth.signOut() to revoke session on server. 2. Await KeychainService.shared.clearAllTokens() to remove credentials. 3. Get userId from currentUser. 4. Fetch user's todos: let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<TodoItem>(predicate: #Predicate { /bin/zsh.userId == userId }). 5. Delete all: for todo in try modelContext.fetch(descriptor) { modelContext.delete(todo) }. 6. Try modelContext.save(). 7. Set isAuthenticated = false, currentUser = nil. Files: ViewModels/AuthViewModel.swift
acceptance_criteria: [ ] signOut() calls Supabase logout, [ ] Keychain tokens cleared, [ ] User's local todos deleted, [ ] modelContext.save() called, [ ] Auth state reset to false, [ ] No user data remains after logout, [ ] Next user sees clean state

title: Implement Conflict Resolution (Last-Write-Wins)
description: Add conflict resolution logic in SyncService.syncFromServer(). When merging remote todos with local: if local.needsSync=false, trust server. If local.needsSync=true, compare updatedAt timestamps. Server wins if newer, local wins if newer.
design: Modify Services/SyncService.swift syncFromServer() method. For each remoteTodo in server response: let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<TodoItem>(predicate: #Predicate { /bin/zsh.id == remoteTodo.id }). if let localTodo = try local.fetch(descriptor).first { if localTodo.needsSync == false { // Trust server, overwrite local localTodo.title = remoteTodo.title; localTodo.isCompleted = remoteTodo.isCompleted; localTodo.updatedAt = remoteTodo.updatedAt; localTodo.needsSync = false; try local.update(localTodo); } else { // Conflict: compare timestamps if remoteTodo.updatedAt > localTodo.updatedAt { // Server newer, overwrite local localTodo = remoteTodo.toTodoItem(); localTodo.needsSync = false; try local.update(localTodo); } else { // Local newer, ignore server, will upload later } } } else { // New item from server try local.save(remoteTodo.toTodoItem()) } Files: Services/SyncService.swift
acceptance_criteria: [ ] Clean local items (needsSync=false) accept server updates, [ ] Dirty local items (needsSync=true) compare timestamps, [ ] Server newer overwrites local, [ ] Local newer ignores server, [ ] New server items added to local, [ ] No data loss in conflict scenarios, [ ] Testable: create same todo on 2 devices, verify winner
